Context: I am obsessed with the speed and usefulness of an app on MacOS called AntiNote. You can read and examine its images/gifs on AntiNote.io

What Antinote is:

* Program runs in background
* Hotkey surfaces and dismisses a hyper minimalist translucent notepad
* Notepad but with additional features
   * You're always typing in markdown mode, # Header hierarchy is rendered in a color gradient, other markdown features are rendered with decorations
   * Best description:

<pasted_content id="08de">
Syntax Highlighting / Decorated Source Mode

Syntax remains visible
Markdown syntax stays visible, but the editor decorates it. For example, *text* may appear italicized while the asterisks remain visible, and headings can have different sizes or colors.

Typical implementation: syntax highlighting or editor decorations.
</pasted_content id="08de">

   * Markdown checkboxes will convert into rendered, interactive checkboxes
   * Tab/shift tab to indent the row/selected lines in and out is supported
* Horizontal Carousel of Notes, word wrapped. Scrolling horizontally switches notes. left most note is first, right most is newest, overscrolling on newest note past a threshold creates a new note
   * if any note in the middle or ends are blank, those are automatically removed
* Hero UI feature is its minimalist style. by default theres no chroming, only your window and typed notes that you can scroll up and down.
* 2nd Hero feature: Syntax Highlighting but for code.
   * if first line of note says 'python:' then it will render line 2 onwards in python.
   * If codeblocks are used, ```python ... ```then that codeblock is rendered with python's syntax highlighting, and anything outside stays default markdown

Let me know if you understood this, or you want to open up antinote's website if you want me to point out specific things to take a look at. Assuming you're able to examine Images, Videos and Gifs at a frame by frame level.
